objective: Faithful 1:1 native Roblox port of the web game as Escape from Blockov (Ground Zero raid slice): the player is their own Roblox avatar, enemies are Creator Store models, never the reference game's or the web theme's names; full game feel, UI interactions and player feedback as in the web build; multiplayer in one server

source_authority.serve: rojo serve --port 34872 (plugin connected by the user)

studio.place: EscapeFromBlockov.rbxl (Studio still shows the older place title)

tool_access.notes: Studio MCP via roblox/tools/mcp.py (execute_luau, user_mouse_input, user_keyboard_input, screen_capture, start_stop_play); web captures via tools/pw1.sh

constraints: Never close/reopen/save the place from automation: Rojo live sync only (port 34872); the user saves (Ctrl+S) to keep CreatorAssets
Strip scripts from Creator Store assets
Browser scripts only through tools/pw1.sh; never orphan browsers
No reference-game or web-theme naming in the Roblox port; the web animal theme is web-only
decisions: Player is the user's Roblox avatar (R15 + Animate); web clips retargeted by FK (tools/gen_roll.py)
Layout/colliders/loot/spawners exported from the running web build (tools/export_map.mjs -> tools/convert_map.py)
Server-authoritative inventory (InvOp ops), bullets, damage and loot; client LootView is a 1:1 port of InventoryUI at the 2560x1440 reference
Weapon icons are ViewportFrame renders of the Creator Store gun models (the pack ships no icons)
UI font FredokaOne per docs/art-brief.md (web M PLUS Rounded 1c is not built in)
Gamepad/touch as native adaptations: buttons press the keyboard key they stand for (Controls.onKey), sticks feed a virtual aim cursor; the device follows the last input

evidence.claim: Two-client multiplayer: independent bags, shared-pile race has one winner without duplication, replication to both clients
evidence.method: StudioTestService.ExecuteMultiplayerTestAsync(2) with temporary gated drivers using real remotes
evidence.limits: server-side ordering only; no network latency simulation

evidence.claim: LootView matches the web layout; slot label autoSize and name clipping fixed
LootView drag, split, menu, double-click equip, hotbar rebinding, attachments, hover hotkeys work with real input
LootView warm rebuild 7-9 ms (was 13), cold ~26 ms
evidence.limits: backgrounded Studio on Apple Silicon; no low-end device measured

evidence.claim: All 19 SFX load; no script errors at Play start
Roll animation, blood/hit FX, muzzle, weapon hold, photo mode, controls verified
Gamepad and touch controls drive every web action (movement, aim, fire, actions, LootView, map, photo mode)
evidence.method: Studio Play: injected gamepad buttons + DevPad/DevTouch fixtures + clicks on touch buttons, state read back
evidence.limits: no physical touch device or controller; quick-menu engine selection unexercised

known_limitations: Quest log / tracker / objective toasts and unlock notifications not ported (base-game systems; proposed session task_29b676e5)
Audio ids are Creator Store community uploads: replace with owned/licensed SFX before publishing
CreatorAssets (guns incl. RPG-7 and Recurve Bow, NPCs) exist only in the open place until the user saves
Performance not measured on a low-end/mobile device
Gamepad/touch not yet exercised on physical devices (Studio injection has no stick values or touches)
next_actions: User saves the place (Ctrl+S) to keep CreatorAssets
